new_value: GilbertElliottRule already implements temporally correlated packet loss using a two-state Markov chain. Implementation at lora_medium/chaos.py:107-229, tests at python/tests/sim/test_chaos.py (TestGilbertElliottRule class). The model tracks per-link state, provides configurable Good/Bad transition probabilities and loss rates, and produces bursty loss patterns as verified by test_gilbert_elliott_burst_pattern.
